channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: .NET 11 Preview 7 Brings Updates Across C#, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, and Windows Forms
item.description: Last week Microsoft released .NET 11 Preview 7, with updates across C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, Entity Framework Core, Windows Forms, and F#. C# adds labeled break and continue. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: React Router v8: A Deliberately Boring Release with ESM-Only Builds and Default Middleware
item.description: React Router v8 was released on June 17, 2026, with minimal breaking changes and new baselines. Key updates include an ESM-only build and default middleware settings. React Router v6 and Remix v2 have reached End of Life. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Pandoc: What survives markup conversion?
item.description: With the new release of 3.10.2 I wanted to look a bit more closely into Pandoc and all those different markup languages out there - and what converts with how much "loss". (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.6
item.description: Amazon Bedrock now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.6, SpaceXAI's latest flagship model built for long-running agents and ambitious interactive and visual work. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Bedrock now supports OpenAI models in India
item.description: Amazon Bedrock now supports the OpenAI GPT-5.6 models (Terra and Luna) in India, with India Geo cross-Region inference. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS IAM identity federation to external services is now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud Region
item.description: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) now enables AWS workloads in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany) Region to securely authenticate with external services using short-lived JSON Web Tokens (JWTs). (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Corretto August 2026 Critical Security Patch Updates
item.description: On Aug 18, 2026, Amazon announced critical security patch update (CSPU) for Amazon Corretto Long-Term Support (LTS) and Feature Release (FR) versions of OpenJDK. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AgentCore payments is now generally available in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: Today, AWS announces the general availability of AgentCore payments, a capability within Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that enables AI agents to autonomously discover, access, and pay for paid APIs, MCPs, and content with just a few lines of… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports data profiling and anomaly detection
item.description: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports data profiling and anomaly detection, powered by AWS Glue Data Quality. (1 source: aws)
